headline: METR says AI is doubling Anthropic's pace; data-centre protests sweep Europe
body: A busy day pulling in several directions. METR found Anthropic's AI progress running about twice as fast as before, mostly because of AI itself, lifting Capability Velocity and, as an independent check, Alignment & Control. OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, rated 'Critical' for cyber capability, to vetted defenders, raising Catastrophic Risk by 0.32 on the day. 'Stop Dirty Data Centres' protests ran across Europe, with activists breaching a Microsoft site in Amsterdam, and Tech Backlash rose 0.38, the largest factor move. Rules on AI agents from China's MIIT and UK regulators pulled AI Autonomy down 0.18, and South Korea and US Democrats moved on AI legislation. Reversion, Gatekeeper and Enslaved God rose. Horizon Balance edged up to -10.05 from -10.11.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.4, mostly from the METR finding (+0.37) and GPT-6 Cyber (+0.08), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.07). Gatekeeper +0.4, mostly from the METR finding (+0.31) and GPT-6 Cyber (+0.06), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.06) and smaller items (-0.02). Protector God +0.3, from the METR finding (+0.38) and GPT-6 Cyber (+0.07), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.08) and smaller items (-0.07).
